about.title: Computer Vision Specialist & AI Engineer.
about.intro: I specialize in object detection, image processing, and deep learning, with a core focus on agricultural, medical, and industrial automation. I build and deploy robust, real-world AI detection systems using PyTorch and TensorFlow — from lightweight YOLO architectures for edge deployment to high-accuracy visual recognition for medical and plant disease identification.
about.detailed: My work spans three fronts: agricultural and industrial automation (crop counting, disease classification, precision yield estimation, AI-driven quality control), medical imaging (early disease detection, diagnostic accuracy), and community (Machine Learning mentor at Bangkit Academy 2024 guiding 25+ students; technical lecturer at Mulawarman University for AI, ML, Data Structures & Algorithms, and OOP).
about.research: B.CS. (S.Kom.) from Universitas Mulawarman. Beyond engineering I co-author applied-AI research: multiple Scopus-indexed papers, including Q1 journals in Smart Agricultural Technology and Artificial Intelligence in Agriculture.
about.hobbies: Tinkering with software and hardware — small tools for my own productivity. Gaming across Steam, Epic, GOG and Xbox; occasionally developing games (Unity, Godot, Ren'Py).
